title: codis-agents machine file
description: Settings of the machine shared by every project on it: ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-~/.config}/codis-agents/machine.json, or the file named by CODIS_AGENTS_MACHINE. Read by scripts/config.js.

configVersion.description: Format version (1). A newer one is refused with "update the plugin"; left out, a note.

source.description: Where the numbers come from (a measurement on which machine).

swapMinMB.description: Swap floor in MB for the slot scripts and the preconditions (default 4000: a 4 GiB swap passes); 0 switches the swap check off.

minFreeDiskGB.description: Free disk in GB the preconditions require on the volumes of the worktree and the task folder (default 10); 0 switches it off.

maxDockerChains.description: Chains with acceptance in Docker at once (default 2).

coordinatorContextK.description: The coordinator's context signpost in thousands of tokens (default 700).

total.description: Medium and heavy together at most (default 4).

lockDir.description: Directory of the slot locks, queue and journal; absolute or ~ (default ~/.cache/codis-agents/slots).

legacyLock.description: An older single lock counted as one held heavy slot; absolute or ~, empty for none.

jobsAlone.description: Workers of a full guard run alone (default 6).

jobsShared.description: Workers of a full guard run next to another heavy job (default 3).

extraHeavy.description: The extra heavy slot: false - off; an object - its thresholds; left out - the slot scripts decide by OS.

freePct.description: Minimum free memory over the window, percent (default 50).

swapGrowMB.description: Swap growth over the window that closes the extra slot, MB (default 256).
